title: Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision (2nd Edition)
annotation: Karya kanonikal mendasar mengenai geometri proyektif, matriks kamera, geometri epipolar, triangulasi DLT, dan bundle adjustment.

title: Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications (2nd Edition)
annotation: Buku rujukan komprehensif modern mencakup rekonstruksi multi-pandang, stereo matching, dan estimasi kedalaman visual.

title: Structure-from-Motion Revisited
publisher: IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
annotation: Paper arsitektur COLMAP yang memperkenalkan perbaikan esensial pada estimasi pose, penentuan geometri korespondensi, dan triangulasi skala besar.

title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
authors: Ben Mildenhall, Pratul P. Srinivasan, Matthew Tancik, Jonathan T. Barron, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Ren Ng
annotation: Pondasi representasi pemandangan syaraf kontinu 3D berbasis koordinat dan differentiable volume rendering tanpa mesh diskrit.
